source.text: Histological or cytological or radiological diagnosis of advanced (unresectable and/or metastatic) HCC, MUM, RCC, NSCLC and CRC
Histological or cytological or radiological diagnosis of advanced (unresectable and/or metastatic) HCC, MUM, RCC, NSCLC and CRC
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status 0, or 1.
Has at least one measurable target lesion according to RECIST v1.1 \[Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors\], or mRECIST \[modified RECIST\] for unresectable HCC participants
Unstable central nervous system (CNS) metastases. Participants with previously treated brain metastases may participate provided they are stable

Concurrent secondary malignancy other than that being treated in this study. Exceptions to this exclusion include malignancies treated curatively and have not recurred within 2 years prior to study entry
Active Ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease requiring medication for control.
Known history of uncontrolled human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection.
HCV antibody (HCVAb) positive and HCV viral load (HCV RNA) detectable.
History of allogeneic tissue/organ transplantation (including bone marrow, stem cell, liver, or kidney transplants), except those that do not require immunosuppressive therapy
Currently pregnant, nursing, or planning to become pregnant during the course of study.
